fun_facts: Nico Collins's hometown is Pinson, Alabama, and he attended Clay-Chalkville High School.
Nico Collins also played on his high school's basketball team.
In his final two high school seasons, Nico Collins caught 103 passes for 1,968 yards and 25 touchdowns.
At Michigan, Nico Collins finished his college career with 78 catches, 1,388 receiving yards, and 13 touchdowns.
In 2023, Nico Collins gained 1,297 receiving yards and scored eight touchdowns for the Texans.
